scope: Independent re-derivation of load-bearing quantitative claims from primary literature + current PGx guidelines; internal-consistency audit; in-place corrections on review branch.

definitions.SUPPORTED: Independently reproduced from the cited primary source within rounding; statistical direction and magnitude confirmed.
definitions.SUPPORTED_WITH_NOTE: Reproduced, but requires a clarifying note (framing/denominator/currency).
definitions.OVERSTATED: Claim exceeds what the underlying data/receipt support; corrected in place.
definitions.DISCREPANT: Internal inconsistency across files, or contrast mislabeled vs the paper's actual significant result.
definitions.UNVERIFIABLE: Cannot be computed from the available cohort (e.g., specificity with zero confirmed negatives).
definitions.validated_meaning: Throughout, 'validated' = independently reproduced from cited sources. It NEVER means clinically proven. All results are RUO; no regulatory clearance is implied.

claims.title: PREPARE actionable-carrier relative risk reduction
claims.independently_recomputed_value: RRR=0.8309, Fisher p=0.0536, OR 0.1 (exact 95% CI 0.013-1.052) from control 8/23, intervention 1/17
claims.primary_citation: Chiara Nardini et al., PREPARE gastrointestinal-cancer secondary analysis, PMID 39641926 / PMC11624585, Table 2 (OR 0.1, 0.0-0.8, p=.04 adjusted; Fisher p=0.054 conservative).
claims.corrective_action: No change. Abstract's use of the conservative Fisher p=0.054 (vs the paper's adjusted p=.04) is the more conservative choice and is retained.
claims.notes: Paper reports adjusted OR 0.1 (0.0-0.8) p=.04 as significant; receipt/abstract cite Fisher p=0.054 (borderline). Both disclosed. n=563 is a secondary-analysis subset of 1232 enrolled; manuscript says 'secondary analysis' correctly.

claims.title: PREPARE nonactionable negative-control equivalence
claims.independently_recomputed_value: RRR=0.0409, Fisher p=0.904 from control 46/288, intervention 36/235 (n=523)
claims.notes: Correctly used as negative-control specificity evidence.

claims.title: CYP2C19 clopidogrel ischemic-event risk ratio
claims.claimed_value: 4.28x higher risk in PM/IM (20.2% vs 4.7%), p=6.7e-4
claims.primary_citation: NCVC Genome Registry LAA-stroke cohort, PMID 40944685 / PMC12673833, Table 4; paper univariate HR 4.34 (1.61-11.36), multivariate 5.26 (1.87-14.56).
claims.notes: Full study = 369 LAA-stroke patients (from 1,612 screened); n=210 is the clopidogrel-treated subset (EM 106 + PM/IM 104). Used correctly. Manuscript uses CYP2C19 as outcome-association, not a dosing-concordance case.

claims.title: Nguyen pretreatment-vs-reactive toxicity RRR
claims.independently_recomputed_value: Pretreatment-vs-reactive RRR=0.509 but Fisher p=0.13 (NOT significant); paper's significant result is reactive-vs-wildtype (multivariable OR 3.57, 95% CI 1.02-12.49, p=.029 tox; OR 9.59, 2.70-34.04, p=.001 hosp)
claims.primary_citation: D. Grace Nguyen, Jai N. Patel et al., JCO Precis Oncol 2024, PMID 38935897 / PMC11371106 / DOI 10.1200/PO.23.00623.
claims.corrective_action: Ensure the pretreatment-vs-reactive RRR is presented as a DESCRIPTIVE contrast, not a statistically significant effect. Where a significant Nguyen effect is cited, it must be the reactive-vs-wildtype OR (3.57 tox / 9.59 hosp), which the manuscript body (line 392) does correctly.
claims.notes: Descriptive RRR is fine; the error would be presenting the pretreatment-vs-reactive contrast as significant.

claims.notes: Minor rounding disagreement between two shipped receipts.

claims.title: Toxicity-prediction specificity headline (53/53)
claims.independently_recomputed_value: UNVERIFIABLE: authoritative receipt clinical_validation_audit.json reports toxicity_specificity=null (tn=0, fp=0). The 53 cases are tox_unknown (drug/outcome not both known), NOT confirmed non-toxic, so specificity cannot be estimated.
claims.primary_citation: reports/clinical_validation_audit.json (shipped receipt; states specificity=null with note).
claims.corrective_action: Remove/replace '100% (53/53)' with 'Not estimable from this cohort (0 confirmed toxicity-negative evaluable cases; 53 outcome-unknown)'. Fix README:20, README:73, PUBLICATION_PACKAGE_INDEX:53, SME_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY:21.
claims.notes: This claim contradicts the package's own machine receipt.

claims.title: Clinical-evaluable toxicity sensitivity vs headline
claims.independently_recomputed_value: Clinical-evaluable (drug present AND known outcome, n=6): sensitivity=0.667 (tp=4, fn=2), Wilson CI 30.0-90.3%. The Tier-2 heuristic screen (n=16 scorable) is the one that is 100% (6/6) sensitivity, but its specificity is 10% (1/10), not 100%.
claims.corrective_action: Disambiguate the two metrics in README/index/figures: (i) clinical-evaluable sensitivity 0.667 (4/6); (ii) Tier-2 heuristic sensitivity 100% (6/6) WITH specificity 10% (1/10), PPV 40%. Never pair '6/6 sensitivity' with '53/53 specificity'.
claims.notes: The manuscript body §3.3 already reports the honest Tier-2 profile; the error is concentrated in the summary/audit/README files.

claims.title: Tier-2 heuristic screen full confusion matrix
claims.independently_recomputed_value: Reproduced exactly: tp=6, fn=0, tn=1, fp=9 -> sensitivity 100% (CI 61.0-100), specificity 10% (1/10, CI 1.8-40.4), PPV 40% (6/15), NPV 100% (1/1).
claims.corrective_action: No change to manuscript body. Use these exact numbers when correcting the summary files.
claims.notes: Manuscript body is accurate and honest.

claims.title: PREPARE actionability-classification specificity (523/523)
claims.independently_recomputed_value: Legitimate table-level actionability-classification concordance (nonactionable genotypes correctly classified nonactionable), per prepare_outcome_validation.json. This is DISTINCT from clinical toxicity-prediction specificity.
claims.corrective_action: Do NOT delete. Add a one-line clarifier where it could be confused with clinical tox-prediction specificity so the two are not conflated. VALIDATION_SUMMARY_FIGURES.md already labels it 'table-level'.
claims.notes: Honestly scoped already; needs only disambiguation from B1.

claims.title: CPIC concordance 100% (10/10)
claims.independently_recomputed_value: SUPPORTED but thin: 10 matched calls = 9 DPYD + 1 TPMT; only ~3 are actionable dose-reduction calls (rest Normal Metabolizer->Full-dose). DPYD REDUCE_50 for c.2846A>T / c.1903A>G IM confirmed concordant with CPIC.
claims.corrective_action: Add a note that the denominator is small and mostly Normal-Metabolizer full-dose calls, so 10/10 concordance is real but low-powered.

claims.title: TPMT *3A case labeled 'EXACT' match
claims.claimed_value: LIT-TPMT-001 TPMT *3A: CPIC 'REDUCE_30_70', system 'REDUCE_50', match_type EXACT
claims.independently_recomputed_value: (a) *3A/*1 = Intermediate Metabolizer phenotype: CORRECT. (b) CPIC mercaptopurine IM recommendation is a STARTING-DOSE RANGE of 30-80% of normal (2018 and 2025/26 versions), NOT 'REDUCE_30_70' -> cited range mis-stated. (c) System REDUCE_50 is WITHIN the CPIC range -> defensible, but 'EXACT' is wrong; it is a within-range point approximation.
claims.primary_citation: CPIC TPMT/NUDT15-thiopurine guideline (2018 PMID 30447069; 2025/26 update PMID 41618934 / doi 10.1002/cpt.70209).
claims.corrective_action: Change match_type 'EXACT' -> 'WITHIN_RANGE'; correct '30-70%'/'REDUCE_30_70' -> '30-80% of normal starting dose' in CPIC_ALIGNMENT_SUMMARY.md:41, CPIC_CONCORDANCE_REPORT.md:44, cpic_concordance_report.json:128.

claims.corrective_action: Add currency note. IM range unchanged (30-80%).
